title: Gate 1 constrained weight-edit proposal
comment: Whitelist derived from gate0_5_taxonomy.md (Phase A evidence). The constraint forbids exactly the observed failure modes: coherent/dense ops, early layers, embedding/output tensors. Sparse scalar additive edits on mid/late layers were the only probe class that never collapsed (0/136).

family.description: Tensor family to edit. Embedding/output and norm tensors are forbidden (catastrophic at input boundary; see taxonomy).

layers.description: Layer indices to edit. Early layers (0-10) are forbidden: input-boundary edits propagate catastrophically (taxonomy depth gradient).

operation.description: Only sparse scalar additive edits are allowed. scale/zero/set ops collapse the model (taxonomy: coherent ops lethal).

delta.description: Additive scalar applied to each selected element. Bound by taxonomy: |delta| <= 0.5 absolute AND <= 0.5 x std of target tensor (whichever binds).

scalar_count.description: Number of tensor elements to edit (sparse subset). 512-scalar edits never collapsed in the sweep; cap below the coherence risk.

rationale.description: Proposer's reasoning for this edit (for the autopsy log).

predicted_effect.description: Proposer's predicted effect on the eval metric (recorded for predicted-vs-actual analysis).

safety_net.comment: Beyond schema validation, the harness must: (1) verify each edited tensor is on the whitelist at the given layers; (2) apply under torch.no_grad(); (3) run a post-edit perplexity + degeneracy probe; (4) auto-rollback and score as collapse if ppl > 5x baseline or output degenerates. Schema validity alone is not proof of safety.
